Fetch general overview statistics fetch('http://127.0.0.1:8000/api/stats') .then(res => res.json()) .then(data => setStats(data)) .catch(err => console.error("Stats load failed:", err)); // 2. Fetch specific tab data if (activeTab === 'overview' || activeTab === 'messages') { fetch('http://127.0.0.1:8000/api/messages') .then(res => res.json()) .then(data => setMessages(data)) .catch(err => console.error("Messages fetch failed:", err)); } if (activeTab === 'overview' || activeTab === 'history') { fetch('http://127.0.0.1:8000/api/user-history') .then(res => res.json()) .then(data => setUserHistory(data)) .catch(err => console.error("History fetch failed:", err)); } if (activeTab === 'overview' || activeTab === 'logs') { fetch('http://127.0.0.1:8000/api/logs') .then(res => res.json()) .then(data => setSystemLogs(data)) .catch(err => console.error("Logs fetch failed:", err)); } setLoading(false); }, [activeTab]); const handleLogout = async () => { try { if (auth) { await auth.signOut(); } localStorage.removeItem('kp_session'); navigate('/'); } catch (err) { console.error("Logout failed:", err.message); } }; const getTodayFormatted = () => { const today = new Date(); return today.toLocaleDateString('en-US', { weekday: 'long', year: 'numeric', month: 'long', day: 'numeric' }); }; return (
